parsed.answer: The per-keyboard remapping half of your request has been reported before (PowerToys#33080, #3676, #1460, and also #46257 and #48312 as duplicates). Those tickets say Keyboard Manager currently applies remaps globally to all keyboards. Windows has no public API that identifies which keyboard sent a keypress while also letting the input be suppressed, so the team has not been able to implement it. Add a thumbs-up to the existing tickets rather than opening a new one. In the meantime, a workaround mentioned there is a third-party tool such as AutoHotkey with a toggle, or LuaMacros/Interception-based tools for per-device mapping. The Globe/Fn key detection half was not covered by any past ticket I was shown, so that part is not a known duplicate. The Globe key is likely handled in firmware or by a driver and is not exposed to Windows as a normal key, which would explain why nothing is detected. It may be worth filing that part as its own request.
